explanation: The ITU grid is anchored at 193.1 THz, with channels spaced at 50 GHz or 12.5 GHz. 1550 nm is a wavelength, whereas the grid is defined in frequency; 100 GHz and 50 THz confuse a channel spacing and an arbitrary value with the anchor frequency.
